verdict.rationale: A government IP-office service portal could plausibly offer a virtual assistant or chatbot for filing, renewals, or searches, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes procedural services: patent, trademark and design filings, renewals, oppositions, an online filing guide and scheduling appointments. Nothing shows the portal can be operated through natural-language commands, and the llms.txt probe returned a 404, so there is no agent-oriented index either.
